name: Hide Your Light Under A Bushel
overview: Scripture teaches that believers are called to be the light of the world, visibly reflecting Christ's truth and salvation to all people. Jesus emphasizes that a light is not meant to be hidden under a bushel or concealed, but placed where it can shine brightly and draw attention to God's glory through good works. This calling extends from the Old Testament promise of being a light to the Gentiles (Isaiah 49:6) to the Great Commission to proclaim the gospel to every creature (Mark 16:15), underscoring the believer’s responsibility to openly display the transformative power of Christ.
